# REALM UI components

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill.mjs from packages/ui/components and apps/site/content/components. Do not edit. -->

Every `ui-*` component in `@realmorg/ui` 2.0.0-alpha.3: its file, tags, a usage snippet and its API. This file is long. Find the component in the index, then read only its lines (or search for its heading, such as `## Dialog`).

Load the theme once per page, then either the whole bundle or one file per component. Each file imports the files it depends on, and every file is fetched once.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/theme.css">

<!-- everything -->
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/ui.html"></import-element>

<!-- or only what the page uses -->
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/dialog.html"></import-element>
```

Conventions shared by every component:

- Attributes are typed props. Variants and sizes are attributes: `<ui-button variant="outline" size="sm">`.
- Compound parts place themselves. `<ui-dialog-title>` goes inside `<ui-dialog-header>` with no `slot` attribute.
- Form controls are form-associated: they submit with `name`, reset, validate and follow `<fieldset disabled>`.
- Events use native names where one fits (`change`, `input`, `toggle`, `select`, `close`, `cancel`), so `onchange` works anywhere.
- Style from outside with `::part(name)`, the theme tokens and states such as `ui-button:state(attr-variant-is-ghost)`. Do not put `style="…"` on `ui-*` elements.

<a id="button"></a>

## Button

A form-associated button with variants and sizes that can submit or reset a form, open popovers and invoke commands on dialogs. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/button/).

- File: `button.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-button`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>

<ui-button>Button</ui-button>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"destructive"` \| `"outline"` \| `"secondary"` \| `"ghost"` \| `"link"` | `"default"` | Visual style. |
| `size` | `"default"` \| `"xs"` \| `"sm"` \| `"lg"` \| `"icon"` \| `"icon-xs"` \| `"icon-sm"` \| `"icon-lg"` | `"default"` | Height and padding. The `icon` sizes make a square button. |
| `type` | `"button"` \| `"submit"` \| `"reset"` | `"button"` | What the button does in its form. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables the button. Reflects to the attribute. Also true while the button is inside a disabled `<fieldset>`. |
| `aria-label` | string | | Accessible name, passed to the inner button. Use it for icon-only buttons. Property name: `label`. |
| `aria-description` | string | | Accessible description, passed to the inner button. `ui-tooltip` sets it from its content. Property name: `description`. |
| `popovertarget` | string | | Id of a popover element to toggle. |
| `popovertargetaction` | `"toggle"` \| `"show"` \| `"hide"` | | Action taken on the popover target. |
| `href` | string | | Makes the button a link to this URL. The inner element is an `<a>` instead of a `<button>`, and `type` and the invoker attributes do not apply. `disabled` dims it and stops clicks. |
| `target` | string | | Where a link opens, as on `<a>`. |
| `rel` | string | | Link relation, as on `<a>`. |
| `commandfor` | string | | Id of the element that receives `command`. |
| `command` | string | | Command to invoke, such as `show-modal`, `close`, `request-close`, `toggle-popover`, `show-popover`, `hide-popover` or a custom `--command`. |

### Events

`ui-button` dispatches no events of its own. Listen for `click` as on any element. When native invoker commands are
not supported, the button dispatches a cancelable `command` event on the `commandfor` target with `command` and
`source` properties. Calling `preventDefault()` stops the built-in action.

### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The label and any icons. Slotted `<svg>` elements are sized to `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `button` | The inner native `<button>`, or the `<a>` when `href` is set. |

### CSS states and custom properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--ui-radius-start` | Overrides the start corner radii. `ui-button-group` sets it to `0` to join buttons. |
| `--ui-radius-end` | Overrides the end corner radii. |
| `:state(attr-variant-is-*)`, `:state(attr-size-is-*)` | Set for the current variant and size, for example `ui-button:state(attr-variant-is-outline)`. |

### Forms

`ui-button` is form-associated through `ElementInternals`, so it finds its form even across shadow roots.
`type="submit"` calls `requestSubmit()` on the form, which runs constraint validation and fires `submit`.
`type="reset"` calls `reset()`. The button itself adds no name or value to the submitted data, and the `submit`
event's `submitter` is `null`.

<a id="button-group"></a>

## Button Group

Joins adjacent buttons or toggles into one connected control, such as a toolbar or a split button. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/button-group/).

- File: `button-group.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button-group.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-button-group`, `ui-button-group-text`, `ui-button-group-separator`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button-group.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>

<ui-button-group aria-label="Text alignment">
  <ui-button variant="outline">Left</ui-button>
  <ui-button variant="outline">Center</ui-button>
  <ui-button variant="outline">Right</ui-button>
</ui-button-group>
```

### Parts

| Element | Fills | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-button-group` | | A `role="group"` row or column that joins its children's corners. |
| `ui-button-group-text` | the default slot of `ui-button-group` | A bordered, muted label joined like a button. |
| `ui-button-group-separator` | the default slot of `ui-button-group` | A one-pixel `role="separator"` line between two buttons. |

### Attributes

#### ui-button-group

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal"` \| `"vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | Lays the children out in a row or a column. |

#### ui-button-group-separator

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `"vertical"` \| `"horizontal"` | `"vertical"` | Direction of the line. Use `"horizontal"` in a vertical group. Sets `aria-orientation`. |

### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The grouped buttons. Every child except the first gets `--ui-radius-start: 0` and a `-1px` start margin so borders overlap. Every child except the last gets `--ui-radius-end: 0`. |

### CSS states and custom properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `:state(attr-orientation-is-vertical)` | Set when `orientation="vertical"`. |

The group sets `--ui-radius-start` and `--ui-radius-end` on its children. `ui-button`, `ui-toggle` and
`ui-button-group-text` read them. Other children can use them for their own corner radii.

<a id="calendar"></a>

## Calendar

A month grid date picker that submits an ISO date with its form, with min and max limits, locale formatting and keyboard navigation. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/calendar/).

- File: `calendar.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/calendar.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-calendar`
- Imports for you: `button.html`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/calendar.html"></import-element>

<ui-calendar></ui-calendar>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | `""` | Selected date as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Empty means no selection. |
| `month` | string | | Month shown first, as `YYYY-MM`. Used when the calendar is created. Defaults to the month of `value`, or the current month. |
| `min` | string | | Earliest selectable date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `max` | string | | Latest selectable date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `locale` | string | | Locale for the month title and weekday names. Defaults to the browser locale. |

### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | The selected date. Setting it updates the selection and the submitted value. |

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | none | Fired after the user picks a day. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `header` | The row with the previous and next month buttons and the month title. |
| `grid` | The `<table>` holding the weekday headings and days. |
| `day` | Each day `<button>`. It carries `data-date`, plus `data-outside` for days of the neighbouring months, `data-today` for today, `aria-selected="true"` for the selected day and `disabled` outside `min`/`max`. |

`::part(day)` accepts pseudo-classes such as `:hover` and `:disabled` but not attribute selectors, so the
selected, today and outside colours come from the theme tokens (`--primary`, `--accent`, `--muted-foreground`).

### Forms

`ui-calendar` is form-associated. With a `name`, the form submits `value` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), or nothing when no date is
selected. `form.reset()` restores the `value` attribute, and the browser's form state restore brings back a
selected date after navigation.

<a id="checkbox"></a>

## Checkbox

A form-associated checkbox with a built-in label, indeterminate state and native validation. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/checkbox/).

- File: `checkbox.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/checkbox.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-checkbox`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/checkbox.html"></import-element>

<ui-checkbox>Accept terms and conditions</ui-checkbox>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | boolean | `false` | Whether the box is checked. The attribute is the initial and reset state. The property follows the user. |
| `value` | string | | Value submitted when checked. Without it the form submits `on`. |
| `indeterminate` | boolean | `false` | Shows the mixed state. Visual only. Cleared when the user toggles the box. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables the box. Also true inside a disabled `<fieldset>`. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | The form is invalid until the box is checked. |
| `aria-label` | string | | Accessible name when there is no visible text. Property name: `label`. |

The `name` attribute is read by the form, as on any form-associated element.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | boolean | Current state. Updated when the user toggles the box. Setting it updates the box and the submitted value. |
| `value`, `indeterminate`, `disabled`, `required` | | Mirror the attributes above. |

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | none | Bubbles from the element after the user toggles the box. `checked` is already updated. |
| `input` | none | The native `input` event of the inner checkbox, which is composed and reaches the page. |

### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The label text. It is rendered inside a native `<label>` for the inner checkbox. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `control` | The inner `<input type="checkbox">`. |
| `label` | The `<label>` around the slotted text. |

### CSS states

| State | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `:state(attr-checked)` | Set while the box is checked, for example `ui-checkbox:state(attr-checked)`. |

### Forms

`ui-checkbox` is form-associated. When checked it submits `value`, or `on` without one. When unchecked it submits
nothing. Validity is mirrored from the inner checkbox, so `required` takes part in `checkValidity()` and
`reportValidity()`. `form.reset()` restores the `checked` attribute, and a disabled `<fieldset>` disables the box.

<a id="combobox"></a>

## Combobox

A searchable, form-associated select that filters native option children as you type and submits the chosen value. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/combobox/).

- File: `combobox.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/combobox.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-combobox`, `ui-combobox-empty`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/combobox.html"></import-element>

<ui-combobox aria-label="Framework" placeholder="Select a framework…" width="60">
  <option value="realm">REALM</option>
  <option value="lit">Lit</option>
  <option value="stencil">Stencil</option>
  <option value="fast">FAST</option>
  <option value="vanilla">Vanilla custom elements</option>
</ui-combobox>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-combobox` | | The text input with a chevron and the popover list. Fills its container's width unless `width` is set. |
| `<option>` | (data) | One choice in the list, with a check mark when chosen. |
| `ui-combobox-empty` | `empty` | The text shown when nothing matches, in place of "No results found.". |

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | `""` | The `value` of the chosen option. |
| `placeholder` | string | `"Select…"` | Placeholder of the text input. |
| `width` | number | | Fixed width in spacing units, where `n` means `calc(var(--spacing) * n)`. Without it the combobox fills its container. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables the input. Also true inside a disabled `<fieldset>`. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | The form is invalid until an option is chosen. |
| `aria-label` | string | | Accessible name, passed to the inner input. Property name: `label`. |

### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | The chosen value. Setting it selects the matching option. |

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | none | Fired after the user chooses an option. |

### Child elements

| Element | Attributes read | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<option>` | `value`, `label` (or text), `disabled` | One choice. Options are hidden in place and rendered in the list. Adding, removing or changing options updates the list. |
| `ui-combobox-empty` | | Rich content for the empty state. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `field` | The bordered box around the input and chevron. |
| `input` | The inner text `<input role="combobox">`. |
| `list` | The popover `role="listbox"` element. |
| `option` | Each rendered option (`role="option"`). |
| `empty` | The paragraph shown when nothing matches. |

### Forms

`ui-combobox` is form-associated. With a `name`, it submits `value`, or an empty string when nothing is chosen. With
`required` and no value it reports `valueMissing` with the message "Please select an item." and the validation
bubble points at the input. `form.reset()` restores the `value` attribute.

<a id="field"></a>

## Field

Layout wrappers that pair a form control with its label, description and error message, and group related fields under a legend. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/field/).

- File: `field.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/field.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-field`, `ui-field-content`, `ui-field-description`, `ui-field-group`, `ui-field-set`, `ui-field-legend`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/field.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/label.html"></import-element>

<ui-field>
  <ui-label for="field-email">Email</ui-label>
  <ui-input id="field-email" type="email" placeholder="m@example.com"></ui-input>
  <ui-field-description>We only use it to send receipts.</ui-field-description>
</ui-field>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-field` | | One field: label, control, description and error, stacked (or in a row when horizontal). Role `group`. |
| `ui-label` | (default) | The label of a `ui-field`. A plain child. See [Label](https://realm.js.org/components/label/). |
| `ui-field-content` | (default) | A column that keeps a label and description together beside the control in a horizontal field. |
| `ui-field-description` | (default) | Help text in muted `var(--text-sm)`. Goes in `ui-field`, `ui-field-content` or `ui-field-set`. |
| `ui-field-group` | (default) | A column of fields with a gap of `calc(var(--spacing) * 7)`. |
| `ui-field-set` | | A group of fields under a legend. Role `group`. |
| `ui-field-legend` | `legend` | The heading of a `ui-field-set`. Assigns itself to the `legend` slot, so you do not set `slot`. |

Parts show in source order. Every part's default slot takes any content.

### ui-field attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `"vertical"` \| `"horizontal"` | `"vertical"` | Stacks the parts, or puts them on one row. |
| `invalid` | boolean | `false` | Colours the label with `--destructive`. |
| `error` | string | | Error message shown below the field. Hidden when empty. |

### ui-field-legend attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"label"` | | Uses `var(--text-sm)` instead of `var(--text-base)`. |

The other parts have no attributes.

### CSS parts

| Element | Part | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-field` | `error` | The error paragraph (`role="alert"`). |

### CSS states

| Element | State | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-field` | `:state(attr-invalid)` | Set while `invalid` is present. |
| `ui-field` | `:state(attr-orientation-is-horizontal)` | Set for the horizontal layout. |

<a id="input"></a>

## Input

A form-associated single-line text input that wraps a native input, with native types, constraints and validation. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/input/).

- File: `input.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-input`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input.html"></import-element>

<ui-input aria-label="Email" type="email" placeholder="Email"></ui-input>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | `""` | Current value. The attribute is the initial and reset value. |
| `type` | `"text"` \| `"email"` \| `"password"` \| `"number"` \| `"search"` \| `"tel"` \| `"url"` \| `"date"` \| `"time"` \| `"datetime-local"` \| `"month"` \| `"week"` \| `"color"` | `"text"` | Native input type. |
| `placeholder` | string | | Placeholder text. |
| `autocomplete` | string | | Native autofill hint. |
| `inputmode` | string | | Virtual keyboard hint. |
| `pattern` | string | | Regular expression the value must match. |
| `min` | string | | Minimum for number and date types. |
| `max` | string | | Maximum for number and date types. |
| `step` | string | | Step for number and date types. |
| `minlength` | number | | Minimum length. |
| `maxlength` | number | | Maximum length. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables the input. Also true inside a disabled `<fieldset>`. |
| `readonly` | boolean | `false` | Makes the value read-only. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | The form is invalid while the value is empty. |
| `invalid` | boolean | `false` | Sets `aria-invalid="true"` and the error style. Does not affect validity. |
| `aria-label` | string | | Accessible name, passed to the inner input. Property name: `label`. |

### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | Current value. Updated as the user types. Setting it updates the field and the submitted value. |

Every attribute above is also a property with the same name in camelCase (`label` for `aria-label`).

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | none | The inner input's native `input` event, which is composed and reaches the page. |
| `change` | none | Dispatched from the element (bubbling) when the inner input fires `change`. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `input` | The inner native `<input>`. |

### Forms

`ui-input` is form-associated. It submits `value` under its `name`. Validity is mirrored from the inner input, so
`required`, `type`, `pattern`, `minlength`, `maxlength`, `min`, `max` and `step` all take part in `checkValidity()`
and `reportValidity()`, and the validation bubble points at the inner field. Enter submits the form for the
text-like types. `form.reset()` restores the `value` attribute, and a disabled `<fieldset>` disables the input.

<a id="input-group"></a>

## Input Group

A form-associated text input with start and end addons inside one border, for prefixes, suffixes, icons and inline buttons. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/input-group/).

- File: `input-group.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input-group.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-input-group`, `ui-input-group-addon`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input-group.html"></import-element>

<ui-input-group aria-label="Website" placeholder="example.com">
  <ui-input-group-addon>https://</ui-input-group-addon>
</ui-input-group>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-input-group` | (root) | The bordered box with the native `<input>`. |
| `ui-input-group-addon` | (default) | Text, icons or buttons before or after the input, in muted colour. |

The default slot of each part takes any content.

### Attributes

#### ui-input-group

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | `""` | Current value. The attribute is the initial and reset value. |
| `type` | `"text"` \| `"email"` \| `"password"` \| `"number"` \| `"search"` \| `"tel"` \| `"url"` | `"text"` | Native input type. |
| `placeholder` | string | | Placeholder text. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables the input. Also true inside a disabled `<fieldset>`. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | The form is invalid while the value is empty. |
| `name` | string | | Form field name the value is submitted under. |
| `aria-label` | string | | Accessible name, passed to the inner input. Property name: `label`. |

#### ui-input-group-addon

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | `"inline-start"` \| `"inline-end"` | `"inline-start"` | Places the addon before or after the input. |

### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | Current value. Updated as the user types. Setting it updates the field. |

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | none | The inner input's native `input` event (composed). |
| `change` | none | Dispatched from the element (bubbling) when the inner input fires `change`. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `input` | The inner native `<input>`. |

### Forms

`ui-input-group` is form-associated. It submits the input's `value` under its `name`. Addon content is never
submitted. Validity comes from the inner input (`required` and `type`), Enter submits the form, `form.reset()`
restores the `value` attribute, and a disabled `<fieldset>` disables the input.

<a id="input-otp"></a>

## Input OTP

A one-time code input with one box per character, paste support and a complete event, that submits the whole code with its form. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/input-otp/).

- File: `input-otp.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input-otp.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-input-otp`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input-otp.html"></import-element>

<ui-input-otp></ui-input-otp>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | `""` | The code entered so far. The attribute is the initial and reset value. |
| `length` | number | `6` | Number of boxes. An integer from 1 to 12. |
| `pattern` | string | `"[0-9]"` | Regular expression that a single character must match. |
| `separator` | number | `0` | Adds a gap before every box whose index is a multiple of this number. `0` means no gaps. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables every box. Also true inside a disabled `<fieldset>`. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | The form is invalid until all boxes are filled. |

### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | The current code. Setting it fills the boxes. |

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | none | Fired after each typed, pasted or deleted character. |
| `complete` | `{ value: string }` | Fired when the code reaches `length` characters. |

`complete` is a custom event name. Handle it with `oncomplete` inside a component's markup, as in the example above,
or with `addEventListener("complete", …)`.

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `group` | The row of boxes (`role="group"`). |
| `slot` | Each character box. Boxes that start a new group carry `data-gap`. |

### Forms

`ui-input-otp` is form-associated and submits `value` under its `name`, even when it is incomplete. With `required`
it reports `valueMissing` with the message "Enter the full code." until all boxes are filled. The validation bubble
points at the first empty box, which takes focus. `form.reset()` restores the `value` attribute.

A form-associated set of radio buttons built from native option children, for choosing exactly one value. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/radio-group/).


### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | | The `value` of the chosen option. |
| `orientation` | `"vertical"` \| `"horizontal"` | `"vertical"` | Lays the radios out in a column or a row. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables every radio. Also true inside a disabled `<fieldset>`. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | The form is invalid until an option is chosen. |

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | The chosen value. Setting it checks the matching radio. |

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

### Child elements

| Element | Attributes read | Description |

`ui-radio-group` is form-associated. It submits `value` under its `name`, or nothing while no option is chosen. With

<a id="select"></a>

## Select

A styled, form-associated native select that mirrors its option children, with an optional placeholder and validation. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/select/).

- File: `select.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/select.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-select`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/select.html"></import-element>

<ui-select aria-label="Fruit" width="48">
  <option value="apple">Apple</option>
  <option value="banana">Banana</option>
  <option value="blueberry">Blueberry</option>
  <option value="grapes">Grapes</option>
</ui-select>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-select` | | A native `<select>` styled like an input, with a chevron. Fills its container's width unless `width` is set. |
| `<option>` | (data) | One choice, copied into the native select. |

The select keeps the native `<option>` children rather than separate item parts, so the platform picker, keyboard
handling and mobile UI keep working.

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | `""` | The `value` of the chosen option. |
| `placeholder` | string | | Text of an empty, unselectable first entry. Without it, the first or `selected` option is chosen automatically. |
| `size` | `"default"` \| `"sm"` | `"default"` | Height of the select. |
| `width` | number | | Fixed width in spacing units, where `n` means `calc(var(--spacing) * n)`. Without it the select fills its container. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables the select. Also true inside a disabled `<fieldset>`. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | The form is invalid while the placeholder is shown. |
| `aria-label` | string | | Accessible name, passed to the inner select. Property name: `label`. |

### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | The chosen value. Setting it selects the matching option. |

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | none | Dispatched from the element (bubbling) after the user picks an option. |
| `input` | none | The inner select's native `input` event (composed). |

### Child elements

| Element | Attributes read | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<option>` | `value`, `label` (or text), `disabled`, `selected` | One choice. Options are copied into the inner select and kept in sync. `selected` only picks the initial option when there is no `placeholder` and no `value`. `<optgroup>` is not supported. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `control` | The inner native `<select>`. |

### CSS states

| State | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `:state(attr-size-is-sm)` | Set for the small size. |

### Forms

`ui-select` is form-associated. It submits `value` under its `name` (an empty string while the placeholder is
shown). Validity is mirrored from the inner select, so `required` with a placeholder reports `valueMissing` and the
validation bubble points at the select. `form.reset()` restores the `value` attribute. Without one, the select goes
back to the placeholder, or to the first or `selected` option.

<a id="toggle-group"></a>

## Toggle Group

A form-associated set of toggles where one or several can be pressed, submitting the pressed values as one field. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/toggle-group/).

- File: `toggle-group.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/toggle-group.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-toggle-group`
- Imports for you: `toggle.html`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/toggle-group.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/toggle.html"></import-element>

<ui-toggle-group value="left" aria-label="Text alignment">
  <ui-toggle value="left" aria-label="Align left">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 6h18M3 12h10M3 18h14" /></svg>
  </ui-toggle>
  <ui-toggle value="center" aria-label="Align center">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 6h18M7 12h10M5 18h14" /></svg>
  </ui-toggle>
  <ui-toggle value="right" aria-label="Align right">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 6h18M11 12h10M7 18h14" /></svg>
  </ui-toggle>
</ui-toggle-group>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"single"` \| `"multiple"` | `"single"` | Whether one or several toggles can be pressed. |
| `value` | string | `""` | Pressed toggle values, separated by commas. The attribute is the initial and reset value. |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal"` \| `"vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | Layout direction, and which arrow keys move focus. |

### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | Pressed values as a comma-separated string. Setting it presses the matching toggles. |

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | none | Fired after a toggle in the group is clicked and `value` is updated. |

### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The `ui-toggle` elements. Every child except the first gets `--ui-radius-start: 0`, and every child except the last gets `--ui-radius-end: 0`. |

### Child elements

| Element | Attributes read | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-toggle` | `value`, `pressed` | The group sets each toggle's `pressed` from its own `value`. A toggle's value must not contain a comma. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `group` | The `display: contents` wrapper that carries the `focusgroup` attribute. |

### CSS states

| State | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `:state(attr-orientation-is-vertical)` | Set for the vertical layout. |

### Forms

`ui-toggle-group` is form-associated and submits `value` under its `name`, including an empty string when nothing
is pressed. `form.reset()` restores the `value` attribute and the pressed toggles follow it. The group has no
`disabled` attribute. Disable individual toggles instead.

<a id="alert"></a>

## Alert

A callout box with an optional icon, a title and a description, for messages that need the reader's attention. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/alert/).

- File: `alert.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/alert.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-alert`, `ui-alert-title`, `ui-alert-description`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/alert.html"></import-element>

<ui-alert>
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/></svg>
  <ui-alert-title>Changes saved</ui-alert-title>
  <ui-alert-description>Your profile was updated. It can take a minute to show everywhere.</ui-alert-description>
</ui-alert>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-alert` | | The bordered box. A two-column grid: a leading `<svg>` icon in the first column, everything else in the second. |
| `<svg>` | (default) | Optional icon as a direct child of `ui-alert`. Sized to `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)` and spans the title and description rows. |
| `ui-alert-title` | (default) | The heading line, in medium weight. |
| `ui-alert-description` | (default) | Muted text under the title (tinted destructive in the destructive variant). A grid, so `<p>` and `<ul>` stack. |

Each part has a single default slot that takes any content.

### ui-alert attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"destructive"` | `"default"` | Colour scheme of the alert. |

<a id="avatar"></a>

## Avatar

A round image of a user or entity, with a text fallback while the image loads or when it fails. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/avatar/).

- File: `avatar.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/avatar.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-avatar`, `ui-avatar-image`, `ui-avatar-fallback`, `ui-avatar-group`, `ui-avatar-group-count`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/avatar.html"></import-element>

<ui-avatar>
  <ui-avatar-image src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'%3E%3Crect width='64' height='64' fill='%236366f1'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='32' cy='26' r='12' fill='%23e0e7ff'/%3E%3Cpath d='M10 60c4-14 14-20 22-20s18 6 22 20' fill='%23e0e7ff'/%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Ada Lovelace"></ui-avatar-image>
  <ui-avatar-fallback>AL</ui-avatar-fallback>
</ui-avatar>
<ui-avatar>
  <ui-avatar-fallback>CN</ui-avatar-fallback>
</ui-avatar>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-avatar` | (root) | The circle (or rounded square) that clips its content. |
| `ui-avatar-image` | (default) | The `<img>`, hidden until it has loaded and removed when loading fails. |
| `ui-avatar-fallback` | (default) | Initials or an icon on a muted background, shown until the image loads and when it fails. |
| `ui-avatar-group` | (root) | A row that overlaps its avatars, each with a ring in the background colour. |
| `ui-avatar-group-count` | (default) | A muted 32px circle for a count such as "+3", inside `ui-avatar-group`. |

The default slot of each part takes any content.

### Attributes

#### ui-avatar

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"sm"` \| `"default"` \| `"lg"` | `"default"` | 24px, 32px or 40px square. |
| `shape` | `"circle"` \| `"square"` | `"circle"` | `square` uses `var(--radius-md)` corners. |

#### ui-avatar-image

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | string | | Image URL. |
| `alt` | string | `""` | Alternative text for the image. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `ui-avatar-image` | The `<img>`. |
| `fallback` | `ui-avatar-fallback` | The `<span>` around the fallback content. |

<a id="card"></a>

## Card

A bordered container with a header, body and footer for grouping related content and actions. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/card/).

- File: `card.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/card.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-card`, `ui-card-header`, `ui-card-title`, `ui-card-description`, `ui-card-action`, `ui-card-content`, `ui-card-footer`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/card.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/field.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/label.html"></import-element>

<ui-card>
  <ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-title>Create project</ui-card-title>
    <ui-card-description>Deploy your new project in one click.</ui-card-description>
  </ui-card-header>
  <ui-card-content>
    <ui-field>
      <ui-label for="card-project-name">Name</ui-label>
      <ui-input id="card-project-name" placeholder="Name of your project"></ui-input>
    </ui-field>
  </ui-card-content>
  <ui-card-footer justify="between">
    <ui-button variant="outline">Cancel</ui-button>
    <ui-button>Deploy</ui-button>
  </ui-card-footer>
</ui-card>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-card` | | The bordered panel. A flex column with a gap between its parts. Fills its container's width. |
| `ui-card-header` | (default) | A grid for the title, description and action, with horizontal padding. |
| `ui-card-title` | (default) | A heading (level 3 unless `level` says otherwise) in `var(--text-base)` semibold. Place it in `ui-card-header`. |
| `ui-card-description` | (default) | Supporting text in muted `var(--text-sm)`. Place it in `ui-card-header`. |
| `ui-card-action` | (default) | Content in the header's second column, aligned to the end and spanning the title and description rows. |
| `ui-card-content` | (default) | The body, with horizontal padding. |
| `ui-card-footer` | (default) | A row of actions at the bottom, with a gap and horizontal padding. |

Every part has a single default slot that takes any content.

### ui-card-title attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | number (1 to 6) | `3` | The heading level. Use `1` for a card that is the page's main content and `2` for cards directly under the page heading. |

### ui-card-footer attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `justify` | `"between"` \| `"end"` | | Spreads the children apart, or pushes them to the end. Without it they start at the left. |
| `orientation` | `"vertical"` | | Stacks the children and stretches them to the full width. |

The other parts have no attributes.

### CSS parts

| Element | Part | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-card-title` | `title` | The heading element (`role="heading"` with `aria-level`) around the title text. |

<a id="chart"></a>

## Chart

A small SVG bar, line or area chart drawn from a list of data objects, with one or more series. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/chart/).

- File: `chart.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/chart.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-chart`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/chart.html"></import-element>

<ui-chart x="month" y="desktop" label="Desktop visitors per month"
  data='[{"month":"Jan","desktop":186},{"month":"Feb","desktop":305},{"month":"Mar","desktop":237},{"month":"Apr","desktop":73},{"month":"May","desktop":209},{"month":"Jun","desktop":214}]'>
</ui-chart>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"bar"` \| `"line"` \| `"area"` | `"bar"` | How the series are drawn. |
| `data` | array of objects | `[]` | The data points, one object per category. Accepts JSON in the attribute, or an array through the `data` property or a `_data` binding. |
| `x` | string | `"label"` | Field used for the category labels on the horizontal axis. |
| `y` | string | `"value"` | Field, or comma-separated fields, plotted as series. Non-numeric values count as `0`. |
| `height` | number | `240` | Height of the drawing in SVG units, minimum `80`. The width is 600 units and the chart scales to its container. |
| `label` | string | `"Chart"` | Accessible name of the chart image. |

### Parts

`ui-chart` has no child parts and no slots. It draws everything from its attributes.

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `svg` | The chart `<svg>`. |
| `legend` | The legend under the chart. It has content only when `y` names more than one series. |

### CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--chart-1` … `--chart-5` | Series colours, in order. Defined in `theme.css`. Override them on an ancestor, such as a wrapping `<div>`. |

The axis labels use the element's `color` (muted foreground by default) and the grid lines use `var(--border)`.

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-empty` | | The dashed, centred box. A flex column with a gap between header and content. |
| `ui-empty-header` | (default) | A centred column for media, title and description, capped at `calc(var(--spacing) * 96)`. |
| `ui-empty-media` | (default) | A wrapper above the title for an icon, avatar or image. Place it in `ui-empty-header`. |
| `ui-empty-title` | (default) | A heading (level 3 unless `level` says otherwise) in `var(--text-lg)`. Place it in `ui-empty-header`. |

## Item

A row with media, a title, a description and actions, for lists of people, files, settings or notifications. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/item/).

- File: `item.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/item.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-item`, `ui-item-group`, `ui-item-media`, `ui-item-content`, `ui-item-title`, `ui-item-description`, `ui-item-actions`, `ui-item-header`, `ui-item-footer`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/item.html"></import-element>

<ui-item variant="outline">
  <ui-item-content>
    <ui-item-title>Basic item</ui-item-title>
    <ui-item-description>A simple item with a title and a description.</ui-item-description>
  </ui-item-content>
  <ui-item-actions>

  </ui-item-actions>
</ui-item>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-item` | | One row, laid out as a wrapping flex container with a gap. |
| `ui-item-group` | | A column of items with the role `list`. |
| `ui-item-media` | (default) | A non-shrinking box for an icon, image or avatar. Slotted `<svg>` is sized to `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`. |
| `ui-item-content` | (default) | A flex column that fills the space between media and actions. |
| `ui-item-title` | (default) | The main line, in medium weight. Place it in `ui-item-content`. |
| `ui-item-description` | (default) | Secondary text in muted colour, clamped to two lines. Place it in `ui-item-content`. |
| `ui-item-actions` | (default) | A row of buttons or icons with a small gap. |
| `ui-item-header` | (default) | A full-width row above the rest, children spread apart. |
| `ui-item-footer` | (default) | A full-width row below the rest, children spread apart. |

`ui-item` lays its parts out in source order. Put media first, then content, then actions. Every part has a single
default slot that takes any content.

### ui-item attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"outline"` \| `"muted"` | `"default"` | Border and background style. |
| `size` | `"default"` \| `"sm"` | `"default"` | Padding and gap. |

### ui-item-media attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"icon"` \| `"image"` | `"default"` | `icon` is a `calc(var(--spacing) * 8)` bordered, muted box. `image` is a `calc(var(--spacing) * 10)` rounded box whose `<img>` covers it. `default` is a plain wrapper. |

The other parts have no attributes.

<a id="progress"></a>

## Progress

A horizontal bar showing how far a task has got, built on the native progress element. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/progress/).

- File: `progress.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/progress.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-progress`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/progress.html"></import-element>

<ui-progress value="60" aria-label="Progress"></ui-progress>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number | none | Current value, minimum `0`. When it is left out the bar is indeterminate. |
| `max` | number | `100` | Value that means complete, minimum `1`. |
| `aria-label` | string | | Accessible name, passed to the inner `<progress>`. Property name: `label`. |

### Parts

`ui-progress` has no child parts. Its default slot takes fallback text inside the native `<progress>`, for example
`45%`, which browsers that support `<progress>` do not render.

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `bar` | The native `<progress>` element. Its height is `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)`. |

| `width` | number | none | Width in spacing units (`calc(var(--spacing) * width)`). Without it the skeleton fills its container. |
| `height` | number | none | Height in spacing units. |
| `shape` | `"circle"` | none | Fully rounded corners, and the skeleton does not shrink in a flex row. Use with equal `width` and `height`. |

### CSS parts

None. The skeleton renders no shadow content.

<a id="spinner"></a>

## Spinner

A rotating loading indicator with the status role and an accessible label. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/spinner/).

- File: `spinner.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/spinner.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-spinner`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/spinner.html"></import-element>

<ui-spinner></ui-spinner>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-spinner` | (default) | A rotating arc drawn with an inline `<svg>`. It has no slot and takes no content. |

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | number | `16` | Width and height in pixels. Minimum `8`. |
| `label` | string | `"Loading"` | Accessible name of the spinner. |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"primary"` \| `"muted"` \| `"destructive"` | `"default"` | Colour of the arc. `default` uses `currentColor`. |

### CSS parts

None. Set `color` on the element to use a colour outside the variants.

<a id="table"></a>

## Table

A data table rendered from a list of columns and rows, plus the pattern for building a custom table from component state. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/table/).

- File: `table.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/table.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-table`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/table.html"></import-element>

<ui-table
  caption="A list of your recent invoices."
  columns='[{"key":"invoice","label":"Invoice"},{"key":"status","label":"Status"},{"key":"method","label":"Method"},{"key":"amount","label":"Amount"}]'
  rows='[{"id":"INV001","invoice":"INV001","status":"Paid","method":"Credit card","amount":"$250.00"},{"id":"INV002","invoice":"INV002","status":"Pending","method":"PayPal","amount":"$150.00"},{"id":"INV003","invoice":"INV003","status":"Unpaid","method":"Bank transfer","amount":"$350.00"}]'>
</ui-table>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | array of `{ key: string, label?: string }` | `[]` | The columns, in order. `key` is required and selects the value from each row. `label` is the header text and falls back to `key`. Accepts JSON in the attribute, or an array through the `columns` property or a `_columns` binding. |
| `rows` | array of objects | `[]` | The rows. Each object's values are looked up by column key. Missing values render as empty cells. A row's `id`, when present, keys the row so updates reuse its DOM. Otherwise the index is used. Accepts JSON or an array, like `columns`. |
| `caption` | string | none | Text for the table's `<caption>`, shown under the table. The caption is hidden when this is not set. |

### Properties

`columns` and `rows` are also properties. Assigning a new array re-renders the table:

```html
<ui-table id="people"></ui-table>
<script>
  const table = document.getElementById("people");
  table.columns = [{ key: "name", label: "Name" }, { key: "email", label: "Email" }];
  table.rows = [{ id: 1, name: "Ada", email: "ada@example.com" }];
</script>
```

### Parts

`ui-table` has no child parts and no slots. It renders everything from `columns`, `rows` and `caption`. For cells
with markup, use a native table as shown above.

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `table` | The native `<table>`. |
| `head` | Each header cell (`<th>`). |
| `row` | Each body row (`<tr>`). |
| `cell` | Each body cell (`<td>`). |

Rows get a bottom border and a muted background on hover. Cells do not wrap. Long tables scroll horizontally
inside the element.

<a id="alert-dialog"></a>

## Alert Dialog

A modal dialog with the alertdialog role that interrupts the user with a decision and only closes when an action is chosen. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/alert-dialog/).

- File: `alert-dialog.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/alert-dialog.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-alert-dialog`, `ui-alert-dialog-trigger`, `ui-alert-dialog-header`, `ui-alert-dialog-title`, `ui-alert-dialog-description`, `ui-alert-dialog-footer`, `ui-alert-dialog-action`, `ui-alert-dialog-cancel`
- Imports for you: `button.html`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/alert-dialog.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>

<ui-alert-dialog>
  <ui-alert-dialog-trigger><ui-button variant="outline">Delete account</ui-button></ui-alert-dialog-trigger>
  <ui-alert-dialog-header>
    <ui-alert-dialog-title>Are you absolutely sure?</ui-alert-dialog-title>
    <ui-alert-dialog-description>This permanently deletes your account and removes your data from our servers.</ui-alert-dialog-description>
  </ui-alert-dialog-header>
  <ui-alert-dialog-footer>
    <ui-alert-dialog-cancel>Cancel</ui-alert-dialog-cancel>
    <ui-alert-dialog-action value="delete" variant="destructive">Delete account</ui-alert-dialog-action>
  </ui-alert-dialog-footer>
</ui-alert-dialog>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-alert-dialog` | | The modal `<dialog>` with `role="alertdialog"`, a grid with a gap between the header, content and footer. |
| `ui-alert-dialog-trigger` | `trigger` | Its content, outside the dialog. A click on it focuses the element inside and opens the dialog. |
| `ui-alert-dialog-header` | `header` | A column for the title and description. |
| `ui-alert-dialog-title` | (default) | An `<h2>` in `var(--text-lg)` semibold. Its text becomes the dialog's accessible name. |
| `ui-alert-dialog-description` | (default) | A `<p>` in muted `var(--text-sm)`. Its text becomes the dialog's accessible description. |
| `ui-alert-dialog-footer` | `footer` | A row of actions, aligned to the end and wrapped on narrow screens. |
| `ui-alert-dialog-cancel` | (default) | An outline `ui-button`. Closes the dialog with its `value`. |
| `ui-alert-dialog-action` | (default) | A `ui-button` in the chosen `variant`. Closes the dialog with its `value`. |

Parts with a slot assign themselves to it, so you do not write `slot`. Other content goes between the header and the
footer.

### ui-alert-dialog attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean | `false` | Whether the dialog is open. Setting it opens the dialog modally. Reflects. |

### ui-alert-dialog-action attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | `"action"` | Stored in `returnValue` when the action closes the dialog. |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"destructive"` | `"default"` | The button variant. |

### ui-alert-dialog-cancel attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | `"cancel"` | Stored in `returnValue` when the cancel button closes the dialog. |

### Properties and methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `showModal()` | Opens the dialog modally. |
| `show()` | Same as `showModal()`. |
| `close(value?)` | Closes the dialog. When `value` is given it becomes `returnValue`. |
| `returnValue` | Read-only. The `value` of the chosen action or cancel part, or the value passed to `close(value)`. |
| `open` | Boolean property mirroring the attribute. |

### Commands

| Command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `--show-modal` | Opens the dialog. |
| `--close` | Closes the dialog. |
| `--request-close` | Same as `--close`, because the alert dialog has no cancel step. |

`ui-button` also accepts the commands without the `--` prefix. A plain `<button>` needs the prefix.

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | none | Fired after the dialog has closed. Does not bubble. |

### CSS parts

| Element | Part | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-alert-dialog` | `dialog` | The native `<dialog>` element. |
| `ui-alert-dialog-title` | `title` | The `<h2>`. |
| `ui-alert-dialog-description` | `description` | The `<p>`. |
| `ui-alert-dialog-action`, `ui-alert-dialog-cancel` | `button` | The inner `ui-button`. |
| `ui-alert-dialog-trigger` | `trigger` | The wrapper that listens for clicks. |

<a id="command"></a>

## Command

A searchable list of commands with groups, shortcuts, an empty state and keyboard navigation, used inline or as a command palette inside a dialog. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/command/).

- File: `command.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/command.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-command`, `ui-command-empty`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/command.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/toaster.html"></import-element>

<ui-command onselect="document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toast', { detail: { title: event.detail.label } }))">
  <optgroup label="Suggestions">
    <option value="calendar">Calendar</option>
    <option value="emoji">Search emoji</option>
    <option value="calculator">Calculator</option>
  </optgroup>
  <optgroup label="Settings">
    <option value="profile" data-shortcut="⌘P">Profile</option>
    <option value="billing" data-shortcut="⌘B">Billing</option>
    <option value="settings" data-shortcut="⌘S">Settings</option>
  </optgroup>
</ui-command>
<ui-toaster></ui-toaster>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-command` | | A bordered column with the search input above the filtered list. Fills its container's width. |
| `<optgroup label="…">` | (data) | A group with the label as its heading. Groups after the first are separated by a line. |
| `<option>` | (data) | One row in the list, with the `data-shortcut` hint at the end. |
| `ui-command-empty` | `empty` | The text shown when nothing matches, in place of "No results found.". |

`<option>` and `<optgroup>` are hidden and used only as data. Changing them updates the list. Options
outside a group are listed without a heading.

### ui-command attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placeholder` | string | `"Type a command or search..."` | Placeholder of the search input. |

### Option attributes

| Attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | Sent in `event.detail.value`. Also matched by the search. Defaults to the option text. |
| `label` | Text shown in the list and matched by the search. Defaults to the option text. |
| `data-shortcut` | Shortcut hint shown at the end of the row. Display only. It does not bind a key. |

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `select` | `{ value, label }` | Fired when an option is clicked or Enter is pressed on the highlighted option. Bubbles and is composed. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `search` | The row with the search icon and input. |
| `input` | The search `<input>`. |
| `list` | The scrolling list (`role="listbox"`). |
| `item` | Each option row (`role="option"`). |
| `shortcut` | The shortcut hint in a row. |
| `empty` | The paragraph shown when nothing matches. |

<a id="context-menu"></a>

## Context Menu

A menu of actions that opens at the pointer when the user right-clicks an area, sharing its items with the dropdown menu. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/context-menu/).

- File: `context-menu.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/context-menu.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-context-menu`, `ui-context-menu-trigger`, `ui-context-menu-content`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/context-menu.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/dropdown-menu.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/toaster.html"></import-element>

<ui-context-menu onselect="document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toast', { detail: { title: 'Chose ' + event.detail.value } }))">
  <ui-context-menu-trigger><div>Right click here</div></ui-context-menu-trigger>
  <ui-context-menu-content>
    <ui-menu-item value="back">Back <ui-menu-shortcut>⌘[</ui-menu-shortcut></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item value="forward" disabled>Forward <ui-menu-shortcut>⌘]</ui-menu-shortcut></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item value="reload">Reload <ui-menu-shortcut>⌘R</ui-menu-shortcut></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-separator></ui-menu-separator>
    <ui-menu-checkbox-item value="bookmarks" checked>Show Bookmarks</ui-menu-checkbox-item>
    <ui-menu-separator></ui-menu-separator>
    <ui-menu-label>People</ui-menu-label>
    <ui-menu-radio-group value="pedro">
      <ui-menu-radio-item value="pedro">Pedro Duarte</ui-menu-radio-item>
      <ui-menu-radio-item value="colm">Colm Tuite</ui-menu-radio-item>
    </ui-menu-radio-group>
  </ui-context-menu-content>
</ui-context-menu>
<ui-toaster></ui-toaster>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-context-menu` | | Its parts, with no box of its own. |
| `ui-context-menu-trigger` | (default) | A block around the area. A `contextmenu` event inside it opens the menu at the pointer. |
| `ui-context-menu-content` | (default) | A bordered `popover="auto"` panel with `role="menu"`, positioned at the pointer with `position: fixed`. |
| `ui-menu-*` | (default) | Items, labels, groups, separators and shortcuts. See [Dropdown Menu](https://realm.js.org/components/dropdown-menu/). |

None of the parts has attributes of its own. See [Dropdown Menu](https://realm.js.org/components/dropdown-menu/) for the item attributes
(`value`, `disabled`, `variant`, `checked`).

### Events

| Event | Element | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `select` | `ui-menu-item`, `ui-menu-radio-item` | `{ value }` | Fired when an enabled item is chosen. Bubbles to `ui-context-menu`. The menu closes afterwards. |
| `select` | `ui-menu-checkbox-item` | `{ value, checked }` | Same, with the new checked state. |

### CSS parts

| Element | Part | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-context-menu-trigger` | `trigger` | The wrapper that listens for `contextmenu`. |
| `ui-context-menu-content` | `menu` | The focusgroup wrapper around the items. |

## Dialog

A modal dialog built on the native dialog element, with a trigger, header, title, description, footer, close parts and optional side placement. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/dialog/).

- File: `dialog.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/dialog.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-dialog`, `ui-dialog-trigger`, `ui-dialog-close`, `ui-dialog-header`, `ui-dialog-title`, `ui-dialog-description`, `ui-dialog-footer`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/dialog.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/field.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/label.html"></import-element>

<ui-dialog>
  <ui-dialog-trigger><ui-button variant="outline">Edit profile</ui-button></ui-dialog-trigger>
  <ui-dialog-header>
    <ui-dialog-title>Edit profile</ui-dialog-title>
    <ui-dialog-description>Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you are done.</ui-dialog-description>
  </ui-dialog-header>
  <ui-field>
    <ui-label for="dialog-profile-name">Name</ui-label>
    <ui-input id="dialog-profile-name" value="Pedro Duarte"></ui-input>
  </ui-field>
  <ui-dialog-footer>
    <ui-dialog-close><ui-button variant="outline">Cancel</ui-button></ui-dialog-close>
    <ui-dialog-close value="saved"><ui-button>Save changes</ui-button></ui-dialog-close>
  </ui-dialog-footer>
</ui-dialog>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-dialog` | | The modal `<dialog>`, a grid with a gap between the header, content and footer, plus the close button. |
| `ui-dialog-trigger` | `trigger` | Its content, outside the dialog. A click on it focuses the element inside and opens the dialog. |
| `ui-dialog-header` | `header` | A column for the title and description at the top of the dialog. |
| `ui-dialog-title` | (default) | An `<h2>` in `var(--text-lg)` semibold. Its text becomes the dialog's accessible name. |
| `ui-dialog-description` | (default) | A `<p>` in muted `var(--text-sm)`. Its text becomes the dialog's accessible description. |
| `ui-dialog-footer` | `footer` | A row of actions at the bottom, aligned to the end and wrapped on narrow screens. |
| `ui-dialog-close` | (default) | Its content. A click on it closes the dialog without firing `cancel`. |

Parts with a slot assign themselves to it, so you do not write `slot`. Everything else goes in the default slot, the
dialog body, in source order.

### ui-dialog attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean | `false` | Whether the dialog is open. Setting it opens the dialog modally. Reflects. |
| `side` | `"center"` \| `"top"` \| `"right"` \| `"bottom"` \| `"left"` | `"center"` | Where the dialog sits. Any value other than `center` attaches it to that edge as a full-height or full-width panel. |
| `hide-close` | boolean | `false` | Hides the close button in the top corner. Property name: `hideClose`. |
| `persistent` | boolean | `false` | Ignores Escape and backdrop clicks. The close button and `requestClose()` still work. |
| `label` | string | | Accessible name when there is no `ui-dialog-title`. |
| `description` | string | | Accessible description when there is no `ui-dialog-description`. |

### ui-dialog-close attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | | Stored in the dialog's `returnValue` when it closes. Leave it out to keep the previous value. |

### Properties and methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `showModal()` | Opens the dialog modally. |
| `show()` | Same as `showModal()`. The dialog is always modal. |
| `close(value?)` | Closes the dialog. When `value` is given it becomes `returnValue`. Does not fire `cancel`. |
| `requestClose(value?)` | Fires `cancel`, then closes with `value` unless the event was cancelled. |
| `returnValue` | Read-only. The value passed to the last `close(value)` or `ui-dialog-close`, or `""`. |
| `open` | Boolean property mirroring the attribute. |

### Commands

| Command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `--show-modal` | Opens the dialog. |
| `--close` | Closes the dialog. |
| `--request-close` | Same as `requestClose()`. |

`ui-button` also accepts `show-modal`, `close` and `request-close` without the prefix.

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cancel` | none | Fired before the dialog closes from Escape, a backdrop click, the close button, `requestClose()` or `--request-close`. Cancelable. Does not bubble. |
| `close` | none | Fired after the dialog has closed, however it was closed. Does not bubble. |

### CSS parts

| Element | Part | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-dialog` | `dialog` | The native `<dialog>` element. Style the backdrop with `ui-dialog::part(dialog)::backdrop`. |
| `ui-dialog` | `body` | Wrapper around the default slot. In a centred dialog it adds no box of its own (`display: contents`), so empty content leaves no gap. In a left or right sheet it fills the remaining height. |
| `ui-dialog` | `close` | The close button in the top corner. |
| `ui-dialog-title` | `title` | The `<h2>`. |
| `ui-dialog-description` | `description` | The `<p>`. |
| `ui-dialog-trigger` | `trigger` | The wrapper that listens for clicks. |
| `ui-dialog-close` | `close` | The wrapper that listens for clicks. |
