## Dropdown Menu

A menu of actions that opens from a trigger, with labels, groups, separators, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items, keyboard navigation and a select event. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/dropdown-menu/).

- File: `dropdown-menu.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/dropdown-menu.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-dropdown-menu`, `ui-dropdown-menu-trigger`, `ui-dropdown-menu-content`, `ui-menu-item`, `ui-menu-checkbox-item`, `ui-menu-radio-group`, `ui-menu-radio-item`, `ui-menu-label`, `ui-menu-group`, `ui-menu-separator`, `ui-menu-shortcut`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/dropdown-menu.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/toaster.html"></import-element>

<ui-dropdown-menu onselect="document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toast', { detail: { title: 'Selected ' + event.detail.value } }))">
  <ui-dropdown-menu-trigger><ui-button variant="outline">Open menu</ui-button></ui-dropdown-menu-trigger>
  <ui-dropdown-menu-content>
    <ui-menu-label>My Account</ui-menu-label>
    <ui-menu-group>
      <ui-menu-item value="profile">Profile <ui-menu-shortcut>⇧⌘P</ui-menu-shortcut></ui-menu-item>
      <ui-menu-item value="billing">Billing <ui-menu-shortcut>⌘B</ui-menu-shortcut></ui-menu-item>
      <ui-menu-item value="settings">Settings <ui-menu-shortcut>⌘S</ui-menu-shortcut></ui-menu-item>
    </ui-menu-group>
    <ui-menu-separator></ui-menu-separator>
    <ui-menu-item value="logout" variant="destructive">Log out <ui-menu-shortcut>⇧⌘Q</ui-menu-shortcut></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-dropdown-menu-content>
</ui-dropdown-menu>
<ui-toaster></ui-toaster>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-dropdown-menu` | | Its parts, with no box of its own. |
| `ui-dropdown-menu-trigger` | (default) | An inline block around the trigger. A click on it focuses the element inside and toggles the menu. |
| `ui-dropdown-menu-content` | (default) | A bordered `popover="auto"` panel with `role="menu"`, anchored to the trigger. |
| `ui-menu-item` | (default) | A row with `role="menuitem"`: an optional leading `<svg>`, the label and an optional shortcut. |
| `ui-menu-checkbox-item` | (default) | A row with `role="menuitemcheckbox"` and a check mark when `checked`. |
| `ui-menu-radio-group` | (default) | A group (`role="group"`) that keeps one radio item checked. |
| `ui-menu-radio-item` | (default) | A row with `role="menuitemradio"` and a dot when checked. Place it in `ui-menu-radio-group`. |
| `ui-menu-label` | (default) | A heading row in `var(--text-sm)` medium. Not focusable. |
| `ui-menu-group` | (default) | A block with `role="group"` around related items. |
| `ui-menu-separator` | (default) | A one-pixel line with `role="separator"`. |
| `ui-menu-shortcut` | (default) | Muted `var(--text-xs)` text pushed to the end of its item. Place it in an item. |

The `ui-menu-*` parts work the same in `ui-context-menu-content` and `ui-menubar-content`.

### ui-dropdown-menu-content attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placement` | `"bottom-start"` \| `"bottom-end"` \| `"top-start"` \| `"top-end"` | `"bottom-start"` | Where the menu opens relative to the trigger. |

### ui-menu-item attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | | Sent as `event.detail.value` when the item is chosen. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Ignores clicks and keys, sets `aria-disabled` and skips the item in keyboard navigation. |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"destructive"` | `"default"` | Destructive items use the destructive colour. |

### ui-menu-checkbox-item attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | | Sent in `event.detail.value`. |
| `checked` | boolean | `false` | Whether the item is checked. Toggled when chosen. Reflects. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Ignores clicks and keys and skips the item in keyboard navigation. |

### ui-menu-radio-group and ui-menu-radio-item attributes

| Element | Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-menu-radio-group` | `value` | string | | The checked item's value. Updated when an item is chosen. Reflects. |
| `ui-menu-radio-item` | `value` | string | | The item's value. |
| `ui-menu-radio-item` | `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Ignores clicks and keys and skips the item in keyboard navigation. |

### Events

| Event | Element | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `select` | `ui-menu-item`, `ui-menu-radio-item` | `{ value }` | Fired when an enabled item is clicked or activated with Enter or Space. Bubbles and is composed, so you can listen on `ui-dropdown-menu`. The menu closes afterwards. |
| `select` | `ui-menu-checkbox-item` | `{ value, checked }` | Same, with the new checked state. |

### CSS parts

| Element | Part | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-dropdown-menu-trigger` | `trigger` | The wrapper that listens for clicks. It is the anchor for positioning. |
| `ui-dropdown-menu-content` | `menu` | The focusgroup wrapper around the items. |
| `ui-menu-checkbox-item`, `ui-menu-radio-item` | `indicator` | The check mark or dot. |

### CSS states

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ui-menu-item:state(attr-disabled)` | Matches disabled items. |
| `ui-menu-item:state(attr-variant-is-destructive)` | Matches destructive items. |
| `ui-menu-checkbox-item:state(attr-checked)` | Matches checked checkbox items. Radio items have the same state. |
| `ui-dropdown-menu-content:popover-open` | Matches while the menu is open. |

<a id="hover-card"></a>

## Hover Card

A card that previews the content behind a link when the pointer rests on it or it receives keyboard focus. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/hover-card/).

- File: `hover-card.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/hover-card.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-hover-card`, `ui-hover-card-trigger`, `ui-hover-card-content`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/avatar.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/hover-card.html"></import-element>

<ui-hover-card>
  <ui-hover-card-trigger><ui-button variant="link">@realmorg</ui-button></ui-hover-card-trigger>
  <ui-hover-card-content width="80">
    <div>
      <ui-avatar><ui-avatar-fallback>R</ui-avatar-fallback></ui-avatar>
      <div>
        <strong>@realmorg</strong>
        <span>Native-first custom elements, written as HTML.</span>
        <span>Joined December 2021</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </ui-hover-card-content>
</ui-hover-card>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-hover-card` | | Its parts, with no box of its own. Holds the delays. |
| `ui-hover-card-trigger` | (default) | An inline block around the trigger. Pointer enter and focus schedule the card to open. Pointer leave and focus out schedule it to close. |
| `ui-hover-card-content` | (default) | A bordered `popover="manual"` panel with padding, anchored to the trigger. The pointer over it keeps it open. |

### ui-hover-card attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open-delay` | number | `500` | Milliseconds before the card opens. Minimum `0`. Property name: `openDelay`. |
| `close-delay` | number | `300` | Milliseconds before the card closes. Minimum `0`. Property name: `closeDelay`. |

### ui-hover-card-content attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placement` | `"bottom"` \| `"top"` \| `"left"` \| `"right"` | `"bottom"` | Side of the trigger the card appears on. |
| `width` | number | `64` | Card width in spacing units, where `n` means `calc(var(--spacing) * n)`. |

### CSS parts

| Element | Part | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-hover-card-trigger` | `trigger` | The wrapper that listens for pointer and focus events. |
| `ui-hover-card-content` | `content` | The padded box inside the card. |

<a id="popover"></a>

## Popover

Floating content anchored to a trigger, built on the native popover attribute with light dismiss and placement. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/popover/).

- File: `popover.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/popover.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-popover`, `ui-popover-trigger`, `ui-popover-content`, `ui-popover-header`, `ui-popover-title`, `ui-popover-description`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/field.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/label.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/popover.html"></import-element>

<ui-popover>
  <ui-popover-trigger><ui-button variant="outline">Open popover</ui-button></ui-popover-trigger>
  <ui-popover-content width="80">
    <ui-popover-header>
      <ui-popover-title>Dimensions</ui-popover-title>
      <ui-popover-description>Set the dimensions for the layer.</ui-popover-description>
    </ui-popover-header>
    <ui-field orientation="horizontal">
      <ui-label for="popover-width">Width</ui-label>
      <ui-input id="popover-width" value="100%"></ui-input>
    </ui-field>
    <ui-field orientation="horizontal">
      <ui-label for="popover-height">Height</ui-label>
      <ui-input id="popover-height" value="25px"></ui-input>
    </ui-field>
  </ui-popover-content>
</ui-popover>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-popover` | | Its parts, with no box of its own. |
| `ui-popover-trigger` | (default) | An inline block around the trigger. A click on it focuses the element inside and toggles the content, anchored to the trigger. |
| `ui-popover-content` | (default) | A bordered card with padding, a gap between children and `popover="auto"`. |
| `ui-popover-header` | (default) | A column for the title and description, with a small gap. |
| `ui-popover-title` | (default) | An `<h3>` in `var(--text-sm)` medium. |
| `ui-popover-description` | (default) | A `<p>` in muted `var(--text-sm)`. |

### ui-popover-content attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placement` | `"bottom"` \| `"top"` \| `"left"` \| `"right"` | `"bottom"` | Side of the anchor the popover appears on. It flips when there is not enough room. |
| `width` | number | `72` | Width in spacing units, where `n` means `calc(var(--spacing) * n)`. |
| `popover` | `"auto"` \| `"manual"` | `"auto"` | The native popover attribute. Set on connect when missing. |

### Properties and methods

`ui-popover-content` has the native popover methods: `showPopover(options?)`, `hidePopover()` and
`togglePopover(options?)`. Use `:popover-open` to check whether it is open.

### Events

| Event | Element | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beforetoggle` | `ui-popover-content` | `ToggleEvent` | Native. Fired before the popover opens or closes. Cancelable when opening. |
| `toggle` | `ui-popover-content` | `ToggleEvent` | Native. Fired after it opens or closes. `event.newState` is `"open"` or `"closed"`. |

### CSS parts

| Element | Part | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-popover-trigger` | `trigger` | The wrapper that listens for clicks. |
| `ui-popover-title` | `title` | The `<h3>`. |
| `ui-popover-description` | `description` | The `<p>`. |

### CSS states

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ui-popover-content:popover-open` | Native pseudo-class that matches while the popover is shown. |

<a id="sheet"></a>

## Sheet

A modal panel that slides in from an edge of the screen, for navigation, filters or secondary forms. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/sheet/).

- File: `sheet.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/sheet.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-sheet`, `ui-sheet-trigger`, `ui-sheet-close`, `ui-sheet-header`, `ui-sheet-title`, `ui-sheet-description`, `ui-sheet-footer`
- Imports for you: `dialog.html`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/field.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/label.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/sheet.html"></import-element>

<ui-sheet>
  <ui-sheet-trigger><ui-button variant="outline">Open sheet</ui-button></ui-sheet-trigger>
  <ui-sheet-header>
    <ui-sheet-title>Edit profile</ui-sheet-title>
    <ui-sheet-description>Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you are done.</ui-sheet-description>
  </ui-sheet-header>
  <ui-field>
    <ui-label for="sheet-profile-name">Name</ui-label>
    <ui-input id="sheet-profile-name" value="Pedro Duarte"></ui-input>
  </ui-field>
  <ui-field>
    <ui-label for="sheet-profile-username">Username</ui-label>
    <ui-input id="sheet-profile-username" value="@peduarte"></ui-input>
  </ui-field>
  <ui-sheet-footer>
    <ui-sheet-close><ui-button>Save changes</ui-button></ui-sheet-close>
  </ui-sheet-footer>
</ui-sheet>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-sheet` | | A `ui-dialog` attached to the `side` edge. |
| `ui-sheet-trigger` | `trigger` | Its content, outside the sheet. A click on it focuses the element inside and opens the sheet. |
| `ui-sheet-header` | `header` | A column for the title and description at the top. |
| `ui-sheet-title` | (default) | An `<h2>` in `var(--text-lg)` semibold. Its text becomes the sheet's accessible name. |
| `ui-sheet-description` | (default) | A `<p>` in muted `var(--text-sm)`. Its text becomes the sheet's accessible description. |
| `ui-sheet-footer` | `footer` | A row of actions at the bottom, aligned to the end. |
| `ui-sheet-close` | (default) | Its content. A click on it closes the sheet. |

Parts with a slot assign themselves to it, so you do not write `slot`. Everything else goes in the body in source
order.

### ui-sheet attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean | `false` | Whether the sheet is open. Setting it opens the sheet modally. Reflects. |
| `side` | `"top"` \| `"right"` \| `"bottom"` \| `"left"` | `"right"` | The edge the sheet is attached to. |

### Properties and methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `showModal()` | Opens the sheet. |
| `show()` | Same as `showModal()`. |
| `close()` | Closes the sheet. |
| `requestClose()` | Fires `cancel` on the inner dialog, then closes unless it was cancelled. |
| `open` | Boolean property mirroring the attribute. |

### Commands

| Command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `--show-modal` | Opens the sheet. |
| `--close` | Closes the sheet. |
| `--request-close` | Same as `requestClose()`. |

`ui-button` also accepts the commands without the `--` prefix. A plain `<button>` needs the prefix.

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | none | Fired after the sheet has closed. Does not bubble. |

### CSS parts

| Element | Part | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-sheet` | `dialog` | The inner `ui-dialog` element. Its own parts are not exported. |
| `ui-sheet-title` | `title` | The `<h2>`. |
| `ui-sheet-description` | `description` | The `<p>`. |

<a id="toaster"></a>

## Toaster

A live region that shows short, auto-dismissing notifications triggered by a document event or a method call. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/toaster/).

- File: `toaster.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/toaster.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-toaster`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/toaster.html"></import-element>

<ui-button variant="outline" onclick="document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toast', { detail: { title: 'Event created', description: 'Sunday, December 3 at 9:00 AM' } }))">Show toast</ui-button>
<ui-toaster></ui-toaster>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-toaster` | | The fixed toast list. Each toast is rendered from the data passed to `toast()` or the `toast` event, so there are no toast parts to write. |

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `"bottom-right"` \| `"bottom-left"` \| `"bottom-center"` \| `"top-right"` \| `"top-left"` \| `"top-center"` | `"bottom-right"` | Where toasts appear. |
| `duration` | number | `4000` | Default milliseconds before a toast closes. `0` keeps toasts open until dismissed. Minimum `0`. |

### Toast options

The `detail` of a `toast` event and the argument of `toast()` take the same fields. All are optional.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | `""` | Bold first line. |
| `description` | string | `""` | Muted second line. Hidden when empty. |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"destructive"` | `"default"` | Destructive toasts use the destructive colour. |
| `duration` | number | the `duration` attribute | Milliseconds before this toast closes. `0` keeps it open. |

### Properties and methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `toast(options?)` | Shows a toast and returns its numeric id. |
| `dismiss(id)` | Removes the toast with that id. Unknown ids are ignored. |

### Events

| Event | Target | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toast` | `document` | toast options | Listened for, not dispatched. Every connected `ui-toaster` shows a toast for each event. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `region` | The `<ol>` that holds the toasts (`popover="manual"`, `aria-live="polite"`). |
| `toast` | Each toast `<li>`. Destructive toasts have `data-variant="destructive"`. |

<a id="accordion"></a>

## Accordion

A vertically stacked set of collapsible sections built on native details and summary, with one or several sections open at a time. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/accordion/).

- File: `accordion.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/accordion.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-accordion`, `ui-accordion-item`, `ui-accordion-trigger`, `ui-accordion-content`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/accordion.html"></import-element>

<ui-accordion>
  <ui-accordion-item open>
    <ui-accordion-trigger>Is it accessible?</ui-accordion-trigger>
    <ui-accordion-content>
      Yes. Each item is a native details element, so it works with the keyboard and screen readers.
    </ui-accordion-content>
  </ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item>
    <ui-accordion-trigger>Is it styled?</ui-accordion-trigger>
    <ui-accordion-content>
      Yes. It uses the theme tokens, so it follows your colours, radii and dark mode.
    </ui-accordion-content>
  </ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item>
    <ui-accordion-trigger>Is it animated?</ui-accordion-trigger>
    <ui-accordion-content>The content slides open and shut, and the chevron turns with it.</ui-accordion-content>
  </ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
```

### Parts

| Element | Fills | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-accordion` | | The container. Fills its container's width. |
| `ui-accordion-item` | the default slot of `ui-accordion` | A native `<details>` with a `<summary>` row and a chevron. |
| `ui-accordion-trigger` | the `<summary>` of its `ui-accordion-item` | The summary row's content. Accepts inline markup. |
| `ui-accordion-content` | the body of its `ui-accordion-item` | The content shown when the item is open, with bottom padding. |

### Attributes

#### ui-accordion

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"single"` \| `"multiple"` | `"single"` | In `single` mode, opening an item closes every other open item in the accordion. |

#### ui-accordion-item

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean | `false` | Whether the item is open. Reflects. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Stops the user from opening or closing the item. Setting `open` from script still works. |

`ui-accordion-trigger` and `ui-accordion-content` have no attributes.

### Events

| Event | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggle` | `ui-accordion-item` | Fires when the user opens or closes the item. Bubbles. Read `event.target.open`. Setting `open` from script, including the automatic closing in `single` mode, does not fire it. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `summary` | `ui-accordion-item` | The native `<summary>` row. |

- Tags: `ui-breadcrumb`, `ui-breadcrumb-list`, `ui-breadcrumb-item`, `ui-breadcrumb-link`, `ui-breadcrumb-page`, `ui-breadcrumb-separator`, `ui-breadcrumb-ellipsis`

```html runnable
<ui-breadcrumb>

    <ui-breadcrumb-item><ui-breadcrumb-link href="#">Components</ui-breadcrumb-link></ui-breadcrumb-item>
    <ui-breadcrumb-separator></ui-breadcrumb-separator>
    <ui-breadcrumb-item><ui-breadcrumb-page>Breadcrumb</ui-breadcrumb-page></ui-breadcrumb-item>
  </ui-breadcrumb-list>
</ui-breadcrumb>
```

### Parts

| Element | Fills | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-breadcrumb` | | A `<nav>` landmark named by `label`. |
| `ui-breadcrumb-list` | the `<nav>` of `ui-breadcrumb` | An `<ol>` that lays out items and separators in a wrapping row of small muted text. |
| `ui-breadcrumb-item` | the `<ol>` of `ui-breadcrumb-list` | A list item (`role="listitem"`). |
| `ui-breadcrumb-link` | a `ui-breadcrumb-item` | An `<a>` that turns the foreground colour on hover. |
| `ui-breadcrumb-page` | a `ui-breadcrumb-item` | The current page: a `<span>` with `aria-current="page"` in the foreground colour. |
| `ui-breadcrumb-separator` | the `<ol>`, between items | A chevron, or its own content. Hidden from assistive technology. |
| `ui-breadcrumb-ellipsis` | a `ui-breadcrumb-item` or a button | Three dots with a visually hidden label (default "More"). |

### Attributes

#### ui-breadcrumb

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | `"Breadcrumb"` | Accessible name of the `<nav>` landmark. |

#### ui-breadcrumb-link

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | string | | Link target. |

The other parts have no attributes.

### Slots

| Slot | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (default) | `ui-breadcrumb-separator` | Replaces the chevron, for example with `/`. |
| (default) | `ui-breadcrumb-ellipsis` | The visually hidden label. Defaults to "More". |

### CSS parts

| Part | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list` | `ui-breadcrumb-list` | The `<ol>`. |
| `link` | `ui-breadcrumb-link` | The `<a>`. |
| `page` | `ui-breadcrumb-page` | The `<span>` with `aria-current="page"`. |
| `label` | `ui-breadcrumb-ellipsis` | The visually hidden label. |

<a id="collapsible"></a>

## Collapsible

A single section that shows and hides its content when its trigger is activated, built on native details and summary. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/collapsible/).

- File: `collapsible.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/collapsible.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-collapsible`, `ui-collapsible-trigger`, `ui-collapsible-content`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/collapsible.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/item.html"></import-element>

<ui-collapsible>
  <ui-collapsible-trigger>
    3 starred repositories
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7 15 5 5 5-5M7 9l5-5 5 5" /></svg>
  </ui-collapsible-trigger>
  <ui-collapsible-content>
    <ui-item variant="outline" size="sm">realm/core</ui-item>
    <ui-item variant="outline" size="sm">realm/ui</ui-item>
    <ui-item variant="outline" size="sm">realm/site</ui-item>
  </ui-collapsible-content>
</ui-collapsible>
```

### Parts

| Element | Fills | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-collapsible` | | A native `<details>`. Fills its container's width. |
| `ui-collapsible-trigger` | the `<summary>` of `ui-collapsible` | A row with its content spread to both ends, in small semibold text. Icons are sized to `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`. |
| `ui-collapsible-content` | the body of `ui-collapsible` | A column with `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)` gaps, shown when open. |

### Attributes

#### ui-collapsible

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean | `false` | Whether the content is shown. Reflects. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Stops the user from toggling. Setting `open` from script still works. |

`ui-collapsible-trigger` and `ui-collapsible-content` have no attributes.

### Events

| Event | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggle` | `ui-collapsible` | Fires when the user opens or closes it. Bubbles. Read `event.target.open`. Not fired when `open` is set from script. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | `ui-collapsible` | The native `<summary>`. |

```html runnable
      <ui-menu-item value="redo">Redo <ui-menu-shortcut>⇧⌘Z</ui-menu-shortcut></ui-menu-item>

</ui-menubar>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-menubar` | | The bordered bar, `role="menubar"`, with a gap between menus. |
| `ui-menubar-menu` | (default) | One menu: its trigger and content, with no box of its own. |
| `ui-menubar-trigger` | (default) | A `<button>` with `role="menuitem"` and `aria-haspopup="menu"` in `var(--text-sm)` medium. A click toggles its menu. |
| `ui-menubar-content` | (default) | A bordered `popover="auto"` panel with `role="menu"`, anchored under the trigger. |
| `ui-menu-*` | (default) | Items, labels, groups, separators and shortcuts. See [Dropdown Menu](https://realm.js.org/components/dropdown-menu/). |

None of the menubar parts has attributes of its own. See [Dropdown Menu](https://realm.js.org/components/dropdown-menu/) for the item
attributes and the `select` event.

### CSS parts

| Element | Part | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-menubar` | `bar` | The focusgroup wrapper around the slot. It uses `display: contents`, so it does not affect layout. |
| `ui-menubar-trigger` | `trigger` | The `<button>`. |
| `ui-menubar-content` | `menu` | The focusgroup wrapper around the items. |

### Parts

| Element | Fills | Renders |

| `ui-navigation-menu` | | A `<nav>` landmark named by `label`. |

<a id="pagination"></a>

## Pagination

Page navigation with previous and next controls, numbered pages and ellipses, driven by a page number and a page count. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/pagination/).

- File: `pagination.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/pagination.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-pagination`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/pagination.html"></import-element>

<ui-pagination page="5" total="10"></ui-pagination>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | number | `1` | The current page. Integer, at least 1. Updated by the component when `href` is not set. |
| `total` | number | `1` | Number of pages. Integer, at least 1. |
| `siblings` | number | `1` | Pages shown on each side of the current page. Integer, at least 0. |
| `href` | string | | URL pattern for page links. `{page}` is replaced by the page number. When not set, the controls are buttons that update `page`. |
| `label` | string | `"Pagination"` | Accessible name of the `<nav>` landmark. |

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `{ page: number }` | Fires before the page changes, from Previous, Next or a page number. Bubbles and is cancelable. `preventDefault()` keeps the current page and, in `href` mode, stops the link from navigating. Not fired for the current page or a page out of range. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `list` | The `<ul>` that lays out the controls. |
| `previous` | The Previous control: a `<button>`, or an `<a>` in `href` mode. |
| `next` | The Next control: a `<button>`, or an `<a>` in `href` mode. |
| `page` | Each page number: a `<button>`, or an `<a>` in `href` mode. The current one has `aria-current="page"`. |

### Parts

| Element | Fills | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-sidebar-layout` | | The shell, with an `<aside>` for the sidebar, the inset beside it, and a backdrop on small screens. |
| `ui-sidebar` | the `<aside>` of `ui-sidebar-layout` | The panel, a full-height column. |
| `ui-sidebar-header` | the top of `ui-sidebar` | A padded column for a logo or team switcher. |
| `ui-sidebar-content` | the middle of `ui-sidebar` | A scrolling `<nav>` around the groups. |
| `ui-sidebar-footer` | the bottom of `ui-sidebar` | A padded column for a user menu. |
| `ui-sidebar-group` | `ui-sidebar-content` | A `role="group"` section, named by its label. |
| `ui-sidebar-group-label` | `ui-sidebar-group` | The small muted heading. Hidden when collapsed. |
| `ui-sidebar-menu` | `ui-sidebar-group` | A `<ul>` of menu items with Up and Down arrow navigation. |
| `ui-sidebar-menu-item` | the `<ul>` of `ui-sidebar-menu` | A list item (`role="listitem"`). |
| `ui-sidebar-menu-button` | `ui-sidebar-menu-item` | The item's `<a>`, with icon and text. Icons are sized to `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`. When collapsed, only the icon shows. |
| `ui-sidebar-menu-badge` | `ui-sidebar-menu-item` | Short text, such as a count, at the end of the item. Hidden when collapsed. |
| `ui-sidebar-trigger` | anywhere inside `ui-sidebar-layout` | A ghost icon `ui-button` labelled "Toggle sidebar". |
| `ui-sidebar-inset` | the main area of `ui-sidebar-layout` | A `<main>` panel with rounded corners next to the sidebar. |

### Attributes

#### ui-sidebar-layout

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapsed` | boolean | `false` | Collapses the sidebar to an icon rail (`calc(var(--spacing) * 12)` wide) and hides labels, badges and group labels. Reflects. Ignored on small screens, where the sidebar is off-canvas instead. |
| `persist` | string | | A `localStorage` key. When set, `collapsed` is restored from it on connect and saved to it on every change. |

#### ui-sidebar-menu-button

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | string | | Link target. Without it, the item is a button activated by Enter and Space. |
| `current` | boolean | `false` | Marks the current page with a highlight, medium weight and `aria-current="page"` on the link. |
| `label` | string | | Sets the link's `title`, which is the tooltip when the sidebar is collapsed. |

The other parts have no attributes.

### Properties and methods

| Member | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggle()` | `ui-sidebar-layout` | On wide screens, flips `collapsed`. On small screens, opens or closes the off-canvas sidebar. |

### Events

| Event | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `select` | `ui-sidebar-menu-button` | Fires when the button is clicked. Bubbles and is cancelable. `preventDefault()` stops the link from following its `href`. |
| `sidebartoggle` | `ui-sidebar-trigger` | Fires when the trigger is clicked. Bubbles to the enclosing `ui-sidebar-layout`, which calls `toggle()`. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sidebar` | `ui-sidebar-layout` | The `<aside>` holding the sidebar. Sticky and `100dvh` tall by default. |
| `backdrop` | `ui-sidebar-layout` | The overlay behind the off-canvas sidebar on small screens. Clicking it closes the sidebar. |
| `content` | `ui-sidebar-content` | The scrolling `<nav>`. |
| `menu` | `ui-sidebar-menu` | The `<ul>`. |
| `button` | `ui-sidebar-menu-button` | The `<a>`. |
| `main` | `ui-sidebar-inset` | The `<main>` panel. |

### CSS states and custom properties

- `ui-sidebar-layout:state(attr-collapsed)` matches while collapsed (the same as `[collapsed]`).
- `ui-sidebar-layout:state(state-layout-mobile)` matches when the viewport is narrower than 768px, and
  `:state(state-layout-open)` while the off-canvas sidebar is open.
- The layout sets `--ui-sidebar-width` and `--ui-sidebar-label` (`block` or `none`) for its descendants. Group
  labels and badges use `--ui-sidebar-label` to hide when collapsed.

<a id="tabs"></a>

## Tabs

A set of panels shown one at a time, switched with a row or column of tab buttons. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/tabs/).

- File: `tabs.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/tabs.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-tabs`, `ui-tabs-list`, `ui-tabs-trigger`, `ui-tabs-content`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/card.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/field.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/input.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/label.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/tabs.html"></import-element>

<ui-tabs value="account">
  <ui-tabs-list>
    <ui-tabs-trigger value="account">Account</ui-tabs-trigger>
    <ui-tabs-trigger value="password">Password</ui-tabs-trigger>
  </ui-tabs-list>
  <ui-tabs-content value="account">
    <ui-card>
      <ui-card-header>
        <ui-card-title>Account</ui-card-title>
        <ui-card-description>Make changes to your account here.</ui-card-description>
      </ui-card-header>
      <ui-card-content>
        <ui-field><ui-label for="tabs-name">Name</ui-label><ui-input id="tabs-name" value="Pedro Duarte"></ui-input></ui-field>
      </ui-card-content>
    </ui-card>
  </ui-tabs-content>
  <ui-tabs-content value="password">
    <ui-card>
      <ui-card-header>
        <ui-card-title>Password</ui-card-title>
        <ui-card-description>Change your password here.</ui-card-description>
      </ui-card-header>
      <ui-card-content>
        <ui-field><ui-label for="tabs-password">Current password</ui-label><ui-input id="tabs-password" type="password"></ui-input></ui-field>
      </ui-card-content>
    </ui-card>
  </ui-tabs-content>
</ui-tabs>
```

### Parts

| Element | Fills | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-tabs` | | A flex container for the list and the panels. Fills its container's width. |
| `ui-tabs-list` | the default slot of `ui-tabs` | A `role="tablist"` pill around the triggers, with `aria-orientation` and arrow-key navigation. |
| `ui-tabs-trigger` | the default slot of `ui-tabs-list` | A `<button role="tab">` with `aria-selected` and a roving `tabindex`. |
| `ui-tabs-content` | the default slot of `ui-tabs` | The panel, with `role="tabpanel"`. Hidden unless its `value` is selected. |

### Attributes

#### ui-tabs

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | | The `value` of the selected trigger. If it is missing, unknown or names a disabled trigger, the first enabled trigger is selected. Updated when the user selects a tab. |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal"` \| `"vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | Lays the list out as a row above the panels or a column beside them, and sets which arrow keys move between tabs. |

#### ui-tabs-trigger

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | | Identifies the tab. Selecting it shows the `ui-tabs-content` with the same `value`. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables the tab. |

#### ui-tabs-content

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | string | | The `value` of the trigger that shows this panel. |

`ui-tabs-list` has no attributes.

### Events

| Event | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `ui-tabs` | Fires when the user selects a different tab, by click or keyboard. Read the new `value` from the element. Bubbles. |

### Child elements

`ui-tabs` watches its `ui-tabs-list` and `ui-tabs-content` children and the `value` and `disabled` attributes of
the triggers and panels, so tabs can be added, removed or renamed at any time.

### CSS parts

| Part | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list` | `ui-tabs-list` | The `role="tablist"` container. |
| `trigger` | `ui-tabs-trigger` | The tab button. The selected one has `aria-selected="true"`. |

<a id="aspect-ratio"></a>

## Aspect Ratio

A box that keeps its content at a fixed width-to-height ratio, for images, video and embeds. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/aspect-ratio/).

- File: `aspect-ratio.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/aspect-ratio.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-aspect-ratio`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/aspect-ratio.html"></import-element>

<ui-aspect-ratio ratio="16 / 9">
  <div>16 / 9</div>
</ui-aspect-ratio>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-aspect-ratio` | (default) | A full-width block at the given ratio that clips overflow. Its default slot takes any content. `<img>`, `<video>` and `<iframe>` fill the box and use `object-fit: cover`. |

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ratio` | string | `"16 / 9"` | Width-to-height ratio, as a CSS `aspect-ratio` value. |

### CSS parts

None. The box renders only a slot.

### CSS states and custom properties

The ratio is applied through the reactive custom property `--attr-ratio`, which mirrors the `ratio` attribute.

<a id="carousel"></a>

## Carousel

A scroll-snapping slideshow with previous and next buttons, arrow-key navigation and swipe support. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/carousel/).

- File: `carousel.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/carousel.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-carousel`, `ui-carousel-content`, `ui-carousel-item`, `ui-carousel-previous`, `ui-carousel-next`
- Imports for you: `button.html`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/aspect-ratio.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/card.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/carousel.html"></import-element>

<ui-carousel>
  <ui-carousel-content>
    <ui-carousel-item>
      <ui-card>
        <ui-card-content>
          <ui-aspect-ratio ratio="1"><div>1</div></ui-aspect-ratio>
        </ui-card-content>
      </ui-card>
    </ui-carousel-item>
    <ui-carousel-item>
      <ui-card>
        <ui-card-content>
          <ui-aspect-ratio ratio="1"><div>2</div></ui-aspect-ratio>
        </ui-card-content>
      </ui-card>
    </ui-carousel-item>
    <ui-carousel-item>
      <ui-card>
        <ui-card-content>
          <ui-aspect-ratio ratio="1"><div>3</div></ui-aspect-ratio>
        </ui-card-content>
      </ui-card>
    </ui-carousel-item>
    <ui-carousel-item>
      <ui-card>
        <ui-card-content>
          <ui-aspect-ratio ratio="1"><div>4</div></ui-aspect-ratio>
        </ui-card-content>
      </ui-card>
    </ui-carousel-item>
    <ui-carousel-item>
      <ui-card>
        <ui-card-content>
          <ui-aspect-ratio ratio="1"><div>5</div></ui-aspect-ratio>
        </ui-card-content>
      </ui-card>
    </ui-carousel-item>
  </ui-carousel-content>
  <ui-carousel-previous></ui-carousel-previous>
  <ui-carousel-next></ui-carousel-next>
</ui-carousel>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-carousel-content` | (default) | The scroll-snapping track (`part="track"`). It is focusable and the arrow keys move between slides. |
| `ui-carousel-item` | (default) of `ui-carousel-content` | One slide, the full width (or height) of the track, borders and padding included. |
| `ui-carousel-previous` | (default) | An outline icon button that scrolls to the previous slide. Left of the track, or above it when vertical. |
| `ui-carousel-next` | (default) | An outline icon button that scrolls to the next slide. Right of the track, or below it when vertical. |

The parts place themselves in the carousel's grid, so their source order does not matter. The default slot of
`ui-carousel-item` takes any content.

### Attributes

#### ui-carousel

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal"` \| `"vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | Scroll and snap direction. A vertical carousel needs a `height`. |
| `label` | string | `"Carousel"` | Accessible name of the region. |
| `height` | number | none | Height in spacing units, so `height="56"` is `calc(var(--spacing) * 56)`. Needed for a vertical carousel. |

`ui-carousel-content`, `ui-carousel-item`, `ui-carousel-previous` and `ui-carousel-next` have no attributes.

### Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `{ index: number }` | Fires on `ui-carousel` when scrolling of the track ends. `index` is the zero-based index of the slide in view. Bubbles. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `track` | `ui-carousel-content` | The scroll container holding the slides. |

<a id="direction"></a>

## Direction

A wrapper that sets left-to-right or right-to-left text direction for everything inside it. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/direction/).

- File: `direction.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/direction.html"></import-element>`

```html runnable
<ui-direction dir="rtl">
  <div>
    <ui-breadcrumb label="مسار التنقل">
      <ui-breadcrumb-list>
        <ui-breadcrumb-item><ui-breadcrumb-link href="#">الرئيسية</ui-breadcrumb-link></ui-breadcrumb-item>
        <ui-breadcrumb-separator></ui-breadcrumb-separator>
        <ui-breadcrumb-item><ui-breadcrumb-link href="#">المكونات</ui-breadcrumb-link></ui-breadcrumb-item>

    <ui-input aria-label="بحث" placeholder="ابحث في الوثائق"></ui-input>
    <div>
      <ui-button>حفظ</ui-button>
      <ui-button variant="outline">إلغاء</ui-button>
    </div>
  </div>
</ui-direction>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dir` | `"ltr"` \| `"rtl"` | `"ltr"` | Text direction for the content. Written back to the native `dir` attribute, so it is always present on the element. |

### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The content that takes the direction. |

<a id="resizable"></a>

## Resizable

Panel groups split by draggable handles that users resize with the pointer or the arrow keys. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/resizable/).

- File: `resizable.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/resizable.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-resizable`, `ui-resizable-panel`, `ui-resizable-handle`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/resizable.html"></import-element>

<ui-resizable variant="outline" height="48">
  <ui-resizable-panel size="50">
    <div>One</div>
  </ui-resizable-panel>
  <ui-resizable-handle></ui-resizable-handle>
  <ui-resizable-panel size="50">
    <div>Two</div>
  </ui-resizable-panel>
</ui-resizable>
```

### Attributes

#### ui-resizable

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | `"horizontal"` \| `"vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | Lays the panels out in a row or a column. Handles read it when they connect. |
| `height` | number | none | Height in spacing units, so `height="48"` is `calc(var(--spacing) * 48)`. Without it the group fills its parent's height. |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"outline"` | `"default"` | `outline` adds a 1px border and `var(--radius-lg)` corners. |

#### ui-resizable-panel

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | number | `50` | The panel's share of the group, used as its `flex-grow`. Between 0 and 100. Make the sizes in a group add up to 100 so they read as percentages. Updated while resizing. |
| `min` | number | `10` | The smallest `size` a handle can shrink the panel to. At least 0. |

#### ui-resizable-handle

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handle` | boolean | `false` | Shows a visible grip in the middle of the handle. |

### Properties and methods

`ui-resizable-panel` exposes `size` and `min` as properties. Set `size` from script to resize a panel. The handles
read both properties from the panels on either side.

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-resizable-panel` | (default) | One panel. Its content scrolls when it overflows. |
| `ui-resizable-handle` | (default) | A separator between two panels that resizes them. |

Panels and handles alternate in the default slot of `ui-resizable`. The default slot of a panel takes any content,
including another `ui-resizable`.

### CSS parts

| Part | Element | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `grip` | `ui-resizable-handle` | The grip shown with the `handle` attribute. |

### CSS states and custom properties

- `ui-resizable-handle:state(vertical)` matches handles in a vertical group, which are horizontal lines.
- `ui-resizable-panel` applies its size through the reactive custom property `--attr-size`.

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-scroll-area` | (default) | A clipped box with a focusable scrolling viewport. Its default slot takes any content, which scrolls inside the viewport. |

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `"vertical"` \| `"horizontal"` \| `"both"` | `"vertical"` | Which directions scroll. Overflow in the other direction is clipped. |
| `width` | number | none | Width in spacing units (`calc(var(--spacing) * width)`). Without it the element fills its container. |
| `height` | number | none | Height in spacing units. Without it the element grows with its content and nothing scrolls vertically. |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"outline"` | `"default"` | `outline` adds a 1px border in `var(--border)` with `var(--radius-md)` corners. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `viewport` | The scrolling container. Style `scrollbar-color` or `scrollbar-width` here to change the scrollbar. |

<a id="attachment"></a>

## Attachment

A compact file chip with a preview area, a downloadable file name, its size and optional actions. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/attachment/).

- File: `attachment.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/attachment.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-attachment`, `ui-attachment-media`, `ui-attachment-actions`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/attachment.html"></import-element>

<ui-attachment name="quarterly-report.pdf" size="1.2 MB" href="data:text/plain,Quarterly%20report">
  <ui-attachment-media>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M14 3H6v18h12V7Z" /><path d="M14 3v4h4" /></svg>
  </ui-attachment-media>
</ui-attachment>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-attachment` | (root) | The chip with the file name link and size. |
| `ui-attachment-media` | `media` | A muted rounded square before the name for a file icon (`<svg>`, 16px) or a thumbnail `<img>`. |
| `ui-attachment-actions` | `actions` | A row of buttons after the name, such as remove or open. |

The parts set their own `slot`, so they go directly inside `ui-attachment` with no attributes. The default slot of
each part takes any content.

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | | File name. Shown as the link text and used as the `download` file name. |
| `size` | string | | Human-readable size, such as `1.2 MB`. Hidden when empty. |
| `href` | string | | URL of the file. Without it the name is not a link. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | The column with the name and size. |
| `title` | The file name link. |

<a id="bubble"></a>

## Bubble

A rounded chat bubble for message text, with colour variants, start or end alignment and a reactions row. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/bubble/).

- File: `bubble.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/bubble.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-bubble`, `ui-bubble-reactions`

```html runnable
<ui-message>
  <ui-bubble variant="muted">Did the deploy go out?</ui-bubble>
</ui-message>
<ui-message align="end">
  <ui-bubble align="end">Yes, about ten minutes ago. Everything is green.</ui-bubble>
</ui-message>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-bubble` | (root) | The rounded box around the message content. |
| `ui-bubble-reactions` | `reactions` | A wrapping row below the bubble for reactions or actions. |

`ui-bubble-reactions` sets its own `slot`, so it goes directly inside `ui-bubble` with no attributes. Everything
else in `ui-bubble` is the message content. The default slot of each part takes any content.

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"secondary"` \| `"muted"` \| `"outline"` \| `"ghost"` | `"default"` | Background and text colour. |
| `align` | `"start"` \| `"end"` | `"start"` | `end` sets `align-self: flex-end` on the bubble. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | The rounded box around the message content. |

```html runnable
    <ui-avatar><ui-avatar-fallback>OM</ui-avatar-fallback></ui-avatar>
  </ui-message-avatar>
  <ui-message-header>Olivia Martin</ui-message-header>
  <ui-bubble variant="muted">Hi, how can I help you today?</ui-bubble>
  <ui-message-footer>10:02</ui-message-footer>
</ui-message>
<ui-message align="end">
  <ui-message-avatar>
    <ui-avatar><ui-avatar-fallback>ME</ui-avatar-fallback></ui-avatar>
  </ui-message-avatar>
  <ui-bubble align="end">I cannot sign in to my account.</ui-bubble>
  <ui-message-footer>10:03 · Read</ui-message-footer>
</ui-message>
```

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-message` | (root) | The row, with the avatar beside a column with header, content and footer. |
| `ui-message-avatar` | `avatar` | Wraps a [`ui-avatar`](https://realm.js.org/components/avatar/), aligned to the bottom of the row. |
| `ui-message-header` | `header` | A small muted line above the content, such as the sender name and time. |
| `ui-message-footer` | `footer` | A small muted line below the content, such as the time or a read receipt. |

The parts set their own `slot`, so they go directly inside `ui-message` with no attributes. Any other child (bubbles,
attachments, code blocks) is the message content. The default slot of each part takes any content.

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | `"start"` \| `"end"` | `"start"` | `end` reverses the row and aligns the content to the end. |

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | The column with the header, content and footer. |

<a id="message-scroller"></a>

## Message Scroller

A scrolling chat log that sticks to the newest message and offers a jump-to-latest button when the user scrolls up. [Docs and demos](https://realm.js.org/components/message-scroller/).

- File: `message-scroller.html`, import with `<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/message-scroller.html"></import-element>`
- Tags: `ui-message-scroller`
- Imports for you: `button.html`

```html runnable
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/bubble.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/button.html"></import-element>
<import-element from="https://realm.js.org/dist/ui/components/message-scroller.html"></import-element>

<custom-element name="message-scroller-demo">
  <script type="realm">
    const chat = useState({
      next: 6,
      messages: [
        { id: 1, align: "start", text: "Are we still on for the launch review?" },
        { id: 2, align: "end", text: "Yes, 3pm in the big room." },
        { id: 3, align: "start", text: "Great. Can you bring the metrics?" },
        { id: 4, align: "end", text: "Already in the deck." },
        { id: 5, align: "start", text: "Perfect, see you there." },
      ],
    });

    const REPLIES = ["On my way.", "Running five minutes late.", "Room changed to 4B.", "Starting now."];

    function send() {
      const text = REPLIES[chat.next % REPLIES.length];
      chat.messages.push({ id: chat.next, align: chat.next % 2 ? "start" : "end", text });
      chat.next++;
    }
  </script>

  <style type="realm">
    :host {
      display: grid;
      gap: calc(var(--spacing) * 3);
      width: 100%;
      max-width: calc(var(--spacing) * 112);
    }
    ui-message-scroller {
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    }
    .messages {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
      padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
    }
  </style>

  <ui-message-scroller height="60">
    <div class="messages">
      <repeat-list of="#chat.messages" as="message" key="id">
        <ui-bubble variant="muted" _align="#message.align"><slot name="#message.text"></slot></ui-bubble>
      </repeat-list>
    </div>
  </ui-message-scroller>
  <ui-button variant="outline" onclick="send()">Receive a message</ui-button>
</custom-element>
<message-scroller-demo></message-scroller-demo>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `threshold` | number | `48` | Distance from the bottom, in pixels, within which the scroller stays pinned to new content. Minimum `0`. |
| `height` | number | | Height in spacing units, so `height="60"` is `calc(var(--spacing) * 60)`. Without it, size the scroller from its layout. |

### Parts

| Part | Slot | Renders |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-message-scroller` | (root) | The scrolling log and the "Jump to latest" button. |

The default slot takes the messages and any other content. Any change inside (added nodes, text changes) scrolls to
the bottom while pinned.

### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `viewport` | The scrolling element (`role="log"`, `aria-live="polite"`). |

### CSS states and custom properties

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `:state(attr-height)` | Matches while `height` is set. The height comes from `var(--attr-height)`. |
| `:state(state-scroll-pinned)` | Matches while the view is within `threshold` of the bottom. The "Jump to latest" button is hidden in this state. |
